purpose: Bounded primary-literature audit of empirical cross-horizon comparison for a prospective random tag selected by any family survivor, and verification of the correct model scope.

evidence_tiers.primary_documented: Observation-rule or method documented in an inspected primary source.
evidence_tiers.project_analytic: Original project derivation, independently checked; no theorem novelty claim.
evidence_tiers.project_numerical: Deterministic verification of that derivation, no empirical evidence.
evidence_tiers.bounded_negative_search: Exact application not found in inspected sources; not proof of absence.
evidence_tiers.proposed_only: Unexecuted empirical design subject to dictionary and observation gates.

decision.novelty_status: Not located in a bounded search; no first-ever, new-theorem or new-biological-mechanism claim.
decision.useful_candidate: Parameter-free comparison of selected random-tag survivor functions at common absolute times across family-selection horizons.
decision.scope_correction: Invariance also holds under arbitrary shared deterministic calendar-time rates. It cannot distinguish constant from common changing rates.

queries: "Hidden heterogeneity and circadian-controlled cell fate" lineage survival
search.method: Web search plus direct primary-source inspection and pinned-source text review; earlier broader ledger remains separate.
search.outcome: No exact empirical application located. Relevant known lineage selection and cancer methods retained; unrelated results and reviews not used as evidence.
limits: Not a systematic review across all databases
Not an audit of all source code or every supplement
No guarantee against unindexed, differently named or unpublished prior work
Primary-source absence judgments restricted to inspected scope

derivation.estimand: Q_T(t)=P(prospective random tag alive at t | N(T)>0), 0<=t<=T
assumptions: One founder at a common known origin
Shared deterministic locally bounded nonnegative calendar-time rates
Identical future schedules for both daughters
Complete family survival ascertainment at T
not_implied: Actual tag lifetime law beyond T
Sum of independent elapsed waiting times for arbitrary schedules
derivation.mixture_blind_spot: Q_mix,T(t)=E[h_Z(0,T)*Q_Z(t)]/E[h_Z(0,T)]. Constant-rate types with rates exchanged have identical Q_Z and hence any mixture is horizon invariant despite heterogeneous rates and net growth.
derivation.endpoint_identity: Q_T(T)*h(0,T)=exp(-M(T)); identifies cumulative mortality with a matched prospective denominator, not instantaneous mu.

numerical_check.knowledge_before_freeze: Analytic formula and scope were already derived; numerical grid/functions/tolerances frozen before first numerical run.
numerical_check.calibration: No empirical data or source outcomes used.

empirical_design.status: No empirical protocol or analysis executed by this audit. Requires complete validated trees and a new frozen analysis plan.
empirical_design.contrast: Q_T1(t)-Q_T2(t) at identical absolute t<=min(T1,T2); do not compare Q_T(T) at different t.
empirical_design.fixed_sampling_frame: Same prospective eligible founders for every endpoint; retain never-dividers, extinct families and dead tags; no horizon-dependent inclusion.
empirical_design.exact_tree_weight_option: For complete binary trees U_i(t)=sum over cells alive at t of 2^(-number of ancestral divisions from founder i). Estimate Q_T(t) by averaging U_i(t) over founders with N_i(T)>0. Established chronological weighting, not new method.
empirical_design.dependence: Resample original independent family/experiment clusters and recompute all nested-horizon contrasts jointly; do not count cells, tags or repeated endpoints as independent.
empirical_design.statistical_gate: Freeze horizons/common times, contrasts, uncertainty/multiplicity method and minimum information before viewing outcome curves. Survival labels are not naively exchangeable.
empirical_design.interpretation: Disagreement challenges the conjunction of branching and observation assumptions; cannot distinguish age dependence, inherited states, random environments, interactions or tracking error by itself. Agreement does not validate the full model.

public_artifacts: Original memo/proof/checker and aggregate deterministic results only. Pinned third-party full text and empirical source workbooks stay local/ignored.
